suite.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Readiness Checks
suite.purpose: Local evidence collection and technical readiness checks for an information security management system. This suite is not the ISO/IEC standard and cannot determine or grant certification.
suite.copyrightApproach: Contains original readiness checks and high-level thematic mappings only. It does not reproduce ISO requirement or control text. A licensed copy of the applicable standard and a qualified auditor are required for an authoritative assessment.
suite.certificationBoundary: Only a competent independent certification body can issue an ISO/IEC 27001 certificate. Automated results are readiness evidence, not findings of conformity or nonconformity.

runtimePolicy.allowedTargets: explicitly approved local files, repositories, hosts, ports, and databases only

tests.title: ISMS context and boundary evidence
tests.applicability: All organizations seeking readiness assessment.
tests.localOnlyTool: evidence-indexer: index and cross-reference approved local documents without external access
expectedEvidence: Included systems, teams, sites, and dependencies
tests.limitations: The tool can detect missing or inconsistent records but cannot decide whether the chosen scope is suitable or certify conformity.

tests.title: Climate relevance consideration record
tests.applicability: All assessments using the 2024 amendment.
tests.localOnlyTool: document-query: locate an explicit, dated consideration and linked decisions in local records
tests.limitations: A text match does not establish that the consideration was complete or reasonable.

tests.title: Leadership, policy, and assigned responsibilities
tests.applicability: All organizations.
tests.localOnlyTool: governance-evidence-checker: inspect local approvals, ownership, versions, and policy references
expectedEvidence: Evidence of leadership direction and communication
tests.limitations: Documents cannot prove leadership behavior, organizational commitment, or employee understanding.

tests.title: Risk assessment and treatment traceability
tests.applicability: All organizations; methods and selected treatments vary by context.
tests.localOnlyTool: risk-traceability-checker: validate local record completeness, links, owners, dates, and orphaned treatments
expectedEvidence: Rationale for selected or omitted controls
tests.limitations: Automation cannot determine whether risk judgments, acceptance decisions, or the selected controls are adequate.

tests.title: Resources, competence, awareness, communication, and controlled documentation
tests.applicability: All organizations.
tests.localOnlyTool: support-record-auditor: inspect approved local records for owners, review dates, approvals, completion, and version history
tests.limitations: Completion records do not prove competence or awareness; interviews and sampling remain necessary.

tests.title: Operational execution of risk treatment
tests.applicability: Organizations with approved risk treatments and operational security processes.
tests.localOnlyTool: operation-sampler: correlate local plans with sampled tickets, system records, and reassessment dates
tests.limitations: Sampling can miss failures and cannot establish sustained effectiveness across the full certification period.

tests.title: Measurement, internal audit, and management review evidence
tests.applicability: All operational ISMS programs.
tests.localOnlyTool: assurance-calendar-checker: verify local schedules, coverage, approvals, independence declarations, and action traceability
tests.limitations: The tool cannot judge audit competence, independence in practice, or the quality of management review.

tests.title: Corrective action and continual improvement trail
tests.applicability: Organizations with incidents, audit findings, exceptions, or improvement opportunities.
tests.localOnlyTool: corrective-action-tracer: find unowned, overdue, recurring, or unverified actions in local systems
expectedEvidence: Updates to risks or controls where relevant
tests.limitations: Automated status checks cannot prove that remediation addressed the underlying cause.

tests.title: Information asset inventory and ownership consistency
tests.applicability: Where information, systems, repositories, services, or devices are within ISMS scope.
tests.localOnlyTool: asset-reconciler: compare local inventories with discovered repositories, services, databases, and containers
tests.limitations: Discovery is limited to authorized sources and may not find offline, SaaS, shadow, or physical assets.

tests.title: Access governance and periodic review trail
tests.applicability: Systems with identities, roles, privileged access, or external users.
tests.localOnlyTool: access-review-analyzer: correlate approved local identity and HR exports and flag stale, orphaned, conflicting, or excessive access
tests.limitations: Entitlement risk is context-dependent; findings require system-owner and HR validation.

tests.title: Supplier and external-service security oversight
tests.applicability: Where suppliers or external services can affect in-scope information or operations.
tests.localOnlyTool: supplier-evidence-indexer: cross-reference local supplier records, review dates, scopes, obligations, and unresolved findings
tests.limitations: No external verification is performed; artifact authenticity and supplier practice require human confirmation.

tests.title: Incident readiness and case traceability
tests.applicability: All organizations operating information systems.
tests.localOnlyTool: incident-readiness-checker: validate local playbook coverage and trace sampled alerts through triage, response, closure, and lessons
tests.limitations: Document and ticket review cannot prove readiness under real incident conditions.

tests.title: Continuity and ICT recovery evidence
tests.applicability: Services requiring continued operation or recoverability.
tests.localOnlyTool: recovery-evidence-checker: compare local plans, declared objectives, dependencies, and recorded exercise outcomes
tests.limitations: The suite does not trigger failover or destructive recovery tests unless separately authorized.

tests.title: Legal, contractual, privacy, and records obligations register
tests.applicability: Where legal, regulatory, contractual, privacy, intellectual-property, or recordkeeping duties apply.
tests.localOnlyTool: obligation-mapper: map approved local obligations to owners, systems, evidence, and review dates
tests.limitations: This is not legal advice and cannot establish legal applicability or compliance.

tests.title: Personnel security lifecycle evidence
tests.applicability: Employees, contractors, and relevant third parties with in-scope responsibilities or access.
tests.localOnlyTool: personnel-lifecycle-checker: inspect minimally necessary local metadata for completeness and timely lifecycle actions
tests.limitations: Sensitive HR data must be minimized and access-controlled; legality and adequacy require HR and legal review.

tests.title: Security awareness and role-based competence coverage
tests.applicability: Personnel whose actions can affect information security.
tests.localOnlyTool: training-coverage-analyzer: compare local role requirements with assigned, completed, expired, and overdue learning records
expectedEvidence: Follow-up on failed or missed activities
tests.limitations: Attendance and quiz results do not establish behavior or real-world competence.

tests.title: Remote-working and security-event reporting readiness
tests.applicability: Remote or hybrid personnel and anyone expected to report suspected security events.
tests.localOnlyTool: policy-evidence-checker: inspect local policy coverage, communications, acknowledgement, and reporting-channel evidence
tests.limitations: The tool cannot assess home environments or prove that personnel will recognize and report events.

tests.title: Physical access and protected-area evidence
tests.applicability: Facilities and locations containing in-scope information or equipment.
tests.localOnlyTool: physical-evidence-indexer: sample approved local access and visitor records against site procedures and review schedules
tests.limitations: Requires on-site observation and interviews; local record review cannot validate actual physical safeguards.

tests.title: Equipment, environmental threat, and media lifecycle evidence
tests.applicability: Physical equipment, storage media, utilities, cabling, and facilities in scope.
tests.localOnlyTool: physical-asset-reconciler: correlate local inventories, maintenance, monitoring, movement, reuse, and disposal records
tests.limitations: Automated analysis cannot inspect premises, detect unrecorded media, or validate disposal practices firsthand.

tests.title: Endpoint and secure-configuration baseline drift
tests.applicability: Authorized local endpoint, server, container, and application configuration exports.
tests.localOnlyTool: configuration-diff: compare local snapshots with organization-approved baselines
tests.limitations: Readiness depends on the quality and scope of the organization-approved baseline; no universal ISO configuration is implied.

tests.title: Authentication and privileged-access configuration
tests.applicability: Locally accessible applications, identity configurations, and test accounts within approved scope.
tests.localOnlyTool: auth-config-tester: inspect configuration and perform bounded local authentication/session tests
tests.limitations: Tests use authorized accounts only and do not prove organization-wide identity governance or resistance to every attack.

tests.title: Known-vulnerability and patch exposure scan
tests.applicability: Source trees, dependency manifests, operating-system package inventories, and container images supplied locally.
tests.localOnlyTool: offline-vulnerability-scanner: match local packages against a preloaded, versioned advisory database
tests.limitations: Offline advisory data can become stale; package matching produces false positives and does not establish exploitability.

tests.title: Malware-protection and execution-control evidence
tests.applicability: Systems where malicious code or unauthorized execution presents a relevant risk.
tests.localOnlyTool: endpoint-protection-evidence-parser: inspect local configuration and sampled logs without uploading files
tests.limitations: The suite does not execute live malware and cannot guarantee detection of unknown threats.

tests.title: Backup, restore, and redundancy evidence
tests.applicability: Information and services with backup, restoration, or availability requirements.
tests.localOnlyTool: backup-evidence-checker: evaluate local job history, retention, failures, and recorded restore tests
tests.limitations: No destructive restore or failover is attempted unless separately authorized; logs alone may not prove recoverability.

tests.title: Logging, monitoring, and time consistency
tests.applicability: Locally available application, identity, operating-system, database, and network logs.
tests.localOnlyTool: log-coverage-analyzer: test expected local events, required fields, retention metadata, alert routing, and clock consistency
tests.limitations: A sample cannot demonstrate continuous coverage, alert quality, or response effectiveness over time.

tests.title: Network exposure and service segregation
tests.applicability: Explicitly authorized local hosts, containers, ports, and network configuration.
tests.localOnlyTool: bounded-local-network-inspector: enumerate only approved local endpoints and compare exposure with declared architecture
tests.limitations: No internet scanning, denial-of-service behavior, or scope expansion is allowed; architecture effectiveness requires expert review.

tests.title: Cryptography and secret-handling configuration
tests.applicability: Software, configuration, repositories, and local endpoints using encryption, keys, tokens, or certificates.
tests.localOnlyTool: crypto-secret-inspector: detect exposed secrets and compare local configuration metadata with organization-approved policy
tests.limitations: The tool must redact secret values; configuration review cannot prove correct cryptographic implementation or key custody.

tests.title: Information deletion, masking, leakage prevention, and test-data safeguards
tests.applicability: Systems processing sensitive information or using production-like test data.
tests.localOnlyTool: data-handling-checker: trace approved local samples and configurations for retention, masking, deletion, and leakage-control evidence
tests.limitations: Sampling cannot prove all copies were deleted or all leakage paths are controlled; sensitive data must be minimized.

tests.title: Secure development, change, and testing workflow
tests.applicability: Organizations developing or changing software and information systems.
tests.localOnlyTool: secure-sdlc-analyzer: inspect local repository and pipeline artifacts for review, testing, approval, and deployment traceability
tests.limitations: Repository evidence cannot prove process adherence outside the sampled projects or that testing is technically sufficient.
